subject: Acme Payments — request for penetration retest & remediation evidence
messages:
From: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@redhillsec.com>
To: security@acme-payments.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: alex.sullivan@redhillsec.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Payments — request to schedule penetration retest

Hi Laura / Acme team,

Thanks for the remediation plan you shared last week. RedHill has reviewed the change log and would like to proceed with a scoped retest focused on the four confirmed findings (auth bypass, KV cache isolation, JWT key rotation, and misconfigured CORS). Before we book time, can you: 

- Confirm the remediation artifacts you can provide (patch notes, test logs, and the environment images).
- Confirm whether the fix is deployed to both staging and dedicated-prod replicas.
- Share any constraints on dates (we can do the retest the week of Jul 27–31).

If you can attach a short verification letter or checklist, that speeds vendor validation. We will need the artifacts + access details (IP allowlist, service accounts) at least 48 hours before the retest.

Cheers,
Alex Sullivan
Senior Consultant, RedHill Security
(redhillsec.com)

Attachment: redhill_retest_scope_template.docx (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: alex.sullivan@redhillsec.com, security@acme-payments.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Payments — request to schedule penetration retest

Alex — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below: 

- Artifacts: we can provide (1) remediation summary PDF, (2) pre- and post-fix unit/integration test logs, (3) deployment manifests for staging + prod replicas, and (4) ephemeral service account for the retest. See attachments.
- Deployment: fixes are deployed to staging and pushed to dedicated-prod replicas behind a canary. Aditya and I can open a dedicated canary slice for the retest if you want full prod parity.
- Constraints: Redwood leadership prefers retests after Jul 27; engineering is available Jul 28–30 midday PT.

We also prepared a short verification checklist for the four findings (attached). Please confirm whether RedHill needs any additional documentation (e.g., PKI rotation evidence, exact CVE IDs we referenced). If the retest outcome is clean, we'll issue a formal remediation attestation and a brief verification letter for Acme's security folder.

Thanks — Laura
Director, Enterprise Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_remediation_summary_20260720.pdf (summary, 5 pages); retest-checklist-20260721.xlsx (checklist)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, alex.sullivan@redhillsec.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Payments — request to schedule penetration retest

Hi all — engineering addendum to Laura's note with technical details you asked for: 

1) KV cache isolation (finding #2): patched in runtime v2.3.1 — change: per-tenant cache key hashing and strict TTL enforcement. Post-fix tests: unit + stress tests attached in logs_kvcache_fixes_20260720.zip. Replica status: staging ✅, dedicated-prod canary slice #7 (traffic=5%) ✅.

2) Auth bypass (finding #1): fixed via input validation hardening and an additional authorization gate in front of the internal admin endpoint. There is a migration script that toggles the gate; we ran it in staging and validated with automated negative tests.

3) JWT rotation: key rotation performed 2026-07-19; rotated keys pushed to HSM, new tokens issued with 15m TTL, old key revoked. Rotation logs included in attachments.

4) CORS misconfiguration: tightened server-side origin allowlist and added unit tests. Changes deployed to staging and pushed as part of canary.

Access for retest: we will create a short-lived service account (scope: retest-only, read-only view of logs) and an IP allowlist entry for RedHill scanning ranges. Expect creds + allowlist by 2026-07-26 09:00 PT.

Please confirm whether you require a full prod-slice or can proceed with the canary. If you need prod parity, we'll need a written SLA exception from Acme as discussed earlier.

-Aditya
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachments: logs_kvcache_fixes_20260720.zip (3.4MB - stub)

From: Alex Sullivan <alex.sullivan@redhillsec.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Payments — request to schedule penetration retest

Thanks Laura / Aditya — that level of detail is perfect. RedHill can proceed with the canary slice for the retest; that should be sufficient for validation of the fixes. We will schedule a 4-hour scanning window on Jul 29, 2026 between 10:00–14:00 PT.

Required pre-requisites (please confirm done by Jul 27 EOD PT):
- Service account + credentials delivered to alex.sullivan (do not send in thread; use secure upload).
- IP allowlist entry for RedHill ranges.
- Short verification letter from Redwood stating the four findings were remediated and that changes are live on the canary slice.

We will produce a concise retest report with findings/deltas and a pass/fail statement. If any residual issues are found we will include reproduction steps and severity.

Regards,
Alex

Attachment: retest-schedule-proposal.ics (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: alex.sullivan@redhillsec.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, security@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Payments — request to schedule penetration retest

Alex — thanks. Confirming the following (per your checklist):

- Service account and secure upload: will be delivered via ShareFile by Jul 26 09:00 PT (secure link to Alex).
- IP allowlist: infra will add RedHill ranges and confirm via ticket SEC-472 by Jul 26 EOD.
- Verification letter: attaching a short verification statement that describes the four remediations and environment status. We will follow up with a formal attestation if the retest completes without regressions.

Please confirm receipt of the ShareFile link when available. See the attached verification letter (pdf).

—Laura

Attachment: acme_retest_verification_letter_20260722.pdf (stub)
